title: add-jsonschema-response_format-and-strict-validation-openai-compat
author: Leah Nguyen
description: Adds first-class JSONSchema structured output support via a new response_format parameter, implements strict validation mode with clear error semantics, and updates the OpenAI compatibility adapter to map incoming function/tool calling schemas. Motivation: provide deterministic structured outputs for downstream consumers and make schema validation explicit (strict vs permissive) so callers can opt into hard validation for safety-critical flows. This PR implements: (1) API surface: response_format accepts {type: "json_schema", schema: <stringified JSON Schema>, strict: <boolean>, on_error: <"return_error"|"yield_partial">} and OpenAI-compatible equivalents; (2) Server: validation pipeline that runs streaming-compatible incremental validation to avoid buffering entire responses; (3) Streaming: writer updates to inject validation checkpoints and emit recoverable validation events for client SDKs; (4) OpenAI-compat: adapter normalizes function call schemas to response_format and translates validation errors into OpenAI-style error payloads; (5) SDKs: lightweight helpers in Python/TS to construct response_format payloads and to surface validation events during streaming; (6) Docs and examples showing strict mode semantics and recommended fallback patterns. Backwards compatibility: default behavior unchanged when response_format is not provided. Strict mode is opt-in. The on_error option allows either failing the request with a structured error or returning the partial (best-effort) object plus an error field. Tests: unit tests for schema translation and strict-mode failures, integration tests for streaming validation over long outputs, and e2e tests exercising OpenAI-compat with tools. Rollout plan: feature gated by server flag, staged rollout to 10% of traffic, monitor validation error rate and client adoption. Known limitations: very large schemas may impact latency; complex cross-field dependencies (unevaluatedProperties, dependentSchemas) are validated but may reduce streaming granularity; function-calling mapping is best-effort for mismatched types and will emit warnings in permissive mode.

release_notes: Added response_format JSONSchema support with an opt-in strict validation mode. New parameter allows deterministic structured outputs and configurable on_error handling. SDKs updated with helpers for building response_format payloads. Streaming validations emit client-visible events. Default behavior unchanged when response_format is not provided.
